ITEM 1 | Cubes and chunks of pale off-white starchy vegetable with browned, caramelized edges and patches of golden-brown crust; surfaces matte and slightly dry, pieces roughly 2-3 cm across with some irregular cut faces, clustered in a mound in the upper part of the plate covering about 12% of the plate area, roughly 2 cm tall | 110

ITEM 2 | Sliced yellow squash rounds and wedges in bright yellow with pale cream flesh, plus thin dark green zucchini-type slices with pale interiors; slices are about 0.3-0.5 cm thick and 4-8 cm long, soft-looking with slight sheen and moisture, arranged in a fanned cluster along the left lower edge of the plate covering about 10% of the plate area, roughly 1-1.5 cm tall | 85
